tools.name: make_ad
tools.description: Build a 15-second video ad kit from a business's web page: its homepage, a product page, a restaurant's site. It takes two calls, because the user's email address has to be proved first. Call it with url and email: a code is emailed to the user. Ask them for the code, then call it again with url, em

tools.name: get_ad
tools.description: The state of an ad made with make_ad: its status (queued, running, preview_ready, done or failed) and current step, then the marked preview video, two still images, sample ad copy and the checkout link; once the user has paid, the full kit.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_ad · Public sink: make_ad.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_ad · Public sink: make_ad

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
